children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' game mimicking the conductor arm movements.

avoid: Sudden, jarring movements of the spine or neck.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm sweeps and finger snaps while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the movements with a stable chair nearby for balance.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo and limit the range of the arm sweep.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Wrists cross in front of the chest and sweep outward on the beat.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Free movement of the hips and torso is encouraged.
movement_profile.posture: Upright with hands held at face level.

signature_moves.description: Crossing wrists at the chest and pushing them outward on the first count.
signature_moves.name: The Jerk Sweep

movement_profile.tempo_feel: In time or at half-time with the music.

music_profile.sound_description: Upbeat rhythm and blues characterized by a driving, danceable pulse suitable for sudden, jerky movements.

basic_steps: Cross wrists in front of the chest.
Snap fingers on the first and third counts of the hand motion.
Move hips and legs in rhythm with the arm sweeps.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly due to the repetitive, individual nature of the movements.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time, with movements occurring on the beat or half-beat.
